fields.acceptance: A test in internal/guide (go test -trimpath ./internal/guide) checks the workflows topic has the Outside input section naming bypassPermissions, rhiza.autonomy.plan (as not gating intake), rhiza.daemon.permissionMode, rhiza request, the schedule caveat, permission_mode and rhiza.autonomy.signoff, and the guide's existing size checks still pass
fields.statement: The workflows guide topic has an Outside input section: what the risk warning means (a request's text and --ref reach autonomous agents running in a bypass mode), that every queued request counts and Rhiza cannot see what a scheduled command running rhiza request does, that rhiza.autonomy.plan owner does not gate intake (each request is planned at once under rhiza.daemon.permissionMode; the owner only accepts the plan before the rest runs), and the usual mitigations: people outside Rhiza gate intake (never a schedule), a narrower rhiza.daemon.permissionMode or permission_mode on the plan workflow's steps, and rhiza.autonomy.plan owner and rhiza.autonomy.signoff owner for what runs after; nothing is refused
